causality.higher_timeframe: only H4 buckets whose ending timestamp is no later than the completed M1 decision timestamp
causality.entry_trigger: completed M1 plus completed S5 bars only; entry is the next S5 open
causality.target_evaluation: subsequent executable bid for LONG and ask for SHORT

entry_trigger_iteration.selection_metric_only: raw signal supply before any PnL or target-path calculation

execution_contract.reentry: only after the target bar and one following completed S5 flat-confirmation bar
execution_contract.unresolved: remain unrealized and marked to final executable bid/ask
execution_contract.slippage_stress: 10 percent of exit-bar bid/ask spread, adverse
execution_contract.financing_stress: 1.5 percent annual adverse carry on entry notional, charged for each crossed UTC day
